summary_notes: Inbound sales follow-up to web inquiry from Rufus, operations manager at Kranz and Daughters Plumbing (25 vans + 7 refrigerated box trucks = 32 vehicles). Main goals: fuel cost reduction and dispatch visibility; key pain points are shift handoffs and vehicle location. Current tools: spreadsheets, shared calendar, group texts. Quoted hardware free and $32/vehicle/month on a 36-month agreement. Rep initially claimed 'cancel anytime' and a guaranteed 30% fuel saving with money back, both walked back during the call. Decision maker is CFO Priscilla Kranz-Albright; Rufus does not sign. Written proposal with contract terms due Thursday; demo scheduled next Tuesday at 2 PM.
notable_details: Fleet size corrected mid-call from 25 vans to 32 total vehicles (25 vans plus 7 refrigerated box trucks for commercial water-heater installs)
Pricing: free hardware, $32 per vehicle per month on a standard 36-month agreement; early termination fee is the remaining balance
Decision maker/signer is CFO Priscilla Kranz-Albright; Rufus explicitly does not sign contracts and wants everything in writing
Prospect's top pain point is handoffs when someone is out; second is knowing who is where; fuel cost is the biggest budget concern
Integrations needed: calendar sync (standard) and accounting software (to be covered by the solutions person)
Rural coverage concern raised: rep stated the app saves data locally and syncs when signal returns
Prospect asked about iPad/tablet support; rep confirmed apps for tablets and phones plus web version
